`picture_vba.xlsm` is a synthetic workbook with a cell formula, an embedded PNG, and the XlsxWriter sample VBA project. The project includes a manually callable `say_hello` message-box macro and empty document/sheet modules. The tests open workbooks with macro automation disabled.

Source: https://github.com/jmcnamara/XlsxWriter/blob/main/examples/vbaProject.bin
License: XlsxWriter-LICENSE.txt
